excerpt: Evaluating LLM Delivery in Real Enterprise Workflows Built by Nocoly & Mingdao AI Tech Group on the isomorphic HAP (Hyper Application Platform) testbed, BenchSaaS tests whether models understand business goals, retrieve accurate facts, obey operational constraints, and deliver usable enterprise records across CRM, inventory, and finance. Key Findings of V1.0 Based on 8,850 valid execution runs, general benchmark scores do not directly translate to enterprise delivery. These six takeaways synthesize quality, domain divergence, reasoning tiers, failure causes, and cost efficiency. Leaderboards by Domain, Task Type & Dimension Inspect all 30 model configurations across 100 overall tasks, 3 primary business domains, 7 operational task types, and evaluation dimensions D1–D6. Completion Quality, Latency & Model Cost Align with required completion quality first, then compare median latency and average cost per run. Toggle X-axis metrics or click any model to inspect its Low → Mid → High trajectory. Failure Attribution & Five Representative Case Studies Breakdown of all 863 failed runs across runner and business-rule error codes, paired with five end-to-end execution traces from Chapter 7. About BenchSaaS & Evaluation Methodology Why HAP (APaaS) serves as an ideal enterprise testbed: platform module architecture, 500-task pool vs. 100-task sample composition, reasoning parameters, and comparison boundaries. Download the 51-Page Report or Partner with Us The complete PDF includes all 14 granular D1.1–D5.3 sub-dimension rankings, full raw-log drilldowns across all 863 failures, chart originals, and methodological notes for enterprise selection teams and model labs.
